entries.claim: The pinned Latin Mass data independently corroborate the component's substantive Latin and expose accidental editorial variants for collation.

locator.section: Postcommunion full middle of Per Dominum

entries.claim: The printed Postcommunion supplies nostrum Iesum Christum Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate Spiritus Sancti, Deus. It does not print the terminal Per omnia formula on this page.

The sung Preface dialogue prints Per omnia saecula saeculorum followed by the response Amen. This controls the terminal words and the audible Secret-to-Preface boundary, not the speaker of the Collect response by itself.

RG 115 a gives the complete Father-directed Per Dominum conclusion, including its terminal formula and Amen. It selects the conclusion for this prayer, not a proper-page full printing or a response-speaker identification.

locator.section: RG 480–481, 511 d/i, 513–514; Ordo p. 225 audible Secret-ending rubric and p. 226 sung Preface dialogue

entries.claim: The final secret has an audible Per omnia saecula saeculorum followed by the response Amen. Collects and postcommunions are priestly orations with a separate response. These rules determine the modeled boundaries, not the completeness of a date-specific commemoration inventory.
p. 52 prints the proper prayer body and its abbreviated Per Dominum cue; it does not print the complete expanded conclusion or a terminal response marker.
